entities.name: Satyr
entities.description: Species of carefree woodland beings, part human and part goat, who love pipes, wine and pleasure.

entities.name: Eldraine
entities.description: Plane where satyrs are known as fauns.

entities.name: Fauns
entities.description: Eldraine satyrs who left their forest homes to defend the plane and live in the Tanglespan.

entities.name: Tanglespan
entities.description: Series of bridges and beanstalks across a chasm opened during the invasion.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion that led the fauns to leave their homes.

entities.name: Purphoros
entities.description: God of creativity, artistry and passion worshiped by Theros satyrs.

entities.name: Nylea
entities.description: Goddess of the forest and hunt occasionally honored by satyrs.

events.summary: Fauns of Eldraine leave their homes to join the plane's defense and settle in the Tanglespan.
events.quote: Choosing to leave their homes to join the plane's defense

relations.quote: satyrs are hedonists that worship the god Purphoros
